q: Write an algorithm in pseudocode that receives 6 test scores, then outputs the total and the average.
ms: Example answer (5):

    SET total TO total + score

q: Write an algorithm in pseudocode that receives numbers until -1 is entered, then outputs how many of the numbers were greater than 10.

    IF num > 10 THEN

    END IF
    RECEIVE num FROM (INTEGER) KEYBOARD
END WHILE
SEND count TO DISPLAY

Marks: initialise count (1), sentinel loop on <> -1 (1), selection num > 10 (1), increment inside IF (1), re-input in loop + output (1).

q: Write an algorithm in pseudocode that receives a whole number and outputs whether it is a multiple of both 3 and 5, a multiple of only one of them, or a multiple of neither.
ms: Example answer (5):

RECEIVE n FROM (INTEGER) KEYBOARD
IF (n MOD 3 = 0) AND (n MOD 5 = 0) THEN
    SEND 'Both' TO DISPLAY
ELSE
    IF (n MOD 3 = 0) OR (n MOD 5 = 0) THEN
        SEND 'One' TO DISPLAY
    ELSE
        SEND 'Neither' TO DISPLAY
    END IF
END IF

Marks: input (1), MOD used correctly (1), AND case first (1), OR case (1), neither case + structure (1).

q:
A list `temps` holds 7 daily temperatures.

Write an algorithm in pseudocode that outputs the highest temperature, the lowest temperature, and the average for the week.
ms: Example answer (6):
msCode:
SET high TO temps[0]
SET low TO temps[0]
SET total TO 0
FOR i FROM 0 TO 6 DO
    IF temps[i] > high THEN
        SET high TO temps[i]
    END IF
    IF temps[i] < low THEN
        SET low TO temps[i]
    END IF
    SET total TO total + temps[i]
END FOR
SEND high TO DISPLAY
SEND low TO DISPLAY
SEND total / 7 TO DISPLAY

Marks: sensible initialisation from temps[0] (1), loop over indexes 0–6 (1), high comparison (1), low comparison (1), accumulation (1), all three outputs incl. /7 (1).

q:
A gym wants an algorithm that receives members' visit counts until -1 is entered, then outputs: the number of members processed, the highest visit count, and how many members visited more than 20 times.

Write the algorithm in pseudocode.
ms: Example answer (6):
msCode:
SET members TO 0
SET high TO 0
SET over20 TO 0
RECEIVE visits FROM (INTEGER) KEYBOARD
WHILE visits <> -1 DO
    SET members TO members + 1
    IF visits > high THEN
        SET high TO visits
    END IF
    IF visits > 20 THEN
        SET over20 TO over20 + 1
    END IF
    RECEIVE visits FROM (INTEGER) KEYBOARD
END WHILE
SEND members TO DISPLAY
SEND high TO DISPLAY
SEND over20 TO DISPLAY

Marks: initialisations (1), sentinel loop (1), member counter (1), highest comparison (1), over-20 selection + counter (1), all three outputs (1).
